summary: Mapped the existing DraftReviewr app into harness module boundaries, shared public contracts, integration points, a project manifest, and a phase baseline.
completed_work: Confirmed the current app is a client-heavy Next.js 15 App Router project with React 19 and TypeScript.
Confirmed the authoritative runtime contracts are README.md, package.json, lib/types.ts, lib/storage/local-storage.ts, lib/storage/default-data.json, and lib/openai-client.ts.
Mapped routes /, /admin, and /settings to the document review, admin configuration, and API-key settings surfaces.
Expanded phases/0-onboarding/module-map.json from a placeholder into concrete module boundaries.
Updated phases/project-manifest.json with modules, routes, shared contracts, integration points, current contract summary, and known issues.
Created phases/baselines/0-onboarding.json for future phases to read before targeted implementation.
Marked the onboarding phase and step completed after validation and build checks.
decisions: Treat README.md as product-level context, but do not treat claude.md as authoritative because it describes a stale Supabase/API-route architecture.
Treat lib/storage/local-storage.ts as the central persistence boundary for future work.
Treat lib/openai-client.ts as the AI integration boundary for future review behavior work.
Keep Step 0 read-only for app implementation files; functional changes should be introduced through a new phase.
known_issues: README and settings UI mention GPT-4o or encrypted API-key storage, while current code uses gpt-5 and stores the API key directly in localStorage.
initializeDefaultData fetches /lib/storage/default-data.json; verify browser first-run default loading because the file is not under public/.
DocumentUploadSection does not mark a created document as failed when review processing throws.
package.json does not define a test script.
next_actions: Design the next phase based on the user's first product change request.
Prefer a docs-and-security-alignment or client-runtime-hardening phase before larger feature work if the user asks for stabilization.
Future phases should read phases/baselines/0-onboarding.json and phases/project-manifest.json before targeted source reads.
resume_hint: Start by reading phases/project-manifest.json and phases/baselines/0-onboarding.json. Since all current phases are completed, design a new phase and get user approval before implementing the next feature request.
